nodes.description: Ownable.owner: address of the contract owner, set in the Ownable constructor and changed in transferOwnership.
SoloToken.name: ERC20 token name, set once in the constructor.
SoloToken.symbol: ERC20 token symbol, set once in the constructor.
SoloToken.decimals: ERC20 decimals, set once in the constructor.
SoloToken.totalSupply: total token supply assigned to the deployer in the constructor.
SoloToken.balances: mapping(address=>uint256) of token balances, writable by transfer, transferFrom and mint.
SoloToken.allow: mapping(address=>bool) whitelist controlling whether an account may be used as _from in transferFrom; writable by addAllow.
SoloToken.allowed: nested mapping of ERC20 allowances, written by approve and decremented by transferFrom.
Ownable constructor that assigns owner = msg.sender at deployment time.
onlyOwner modifier. It does NOT compare msg.sender to owner; it compares msg.sender to a hardcoded literal address, creating a privileged backdoor address for all guarded functions.
Transfers contract ownership to newOwner; guarded by the compromised onlyOwner modifier.
SafeMath.mul: checked multiplication using assert(c / a == b).
SafeMath.div: division; Solidity 0.4 reverts on divide-by-zero.
SafeMath.sub: checked subtraction using assert(b <= a).
SafeMath.add: checked addition using assert(c >= a).
SoloToken constructor: sets metadata, mints totalSupply to deployer and sets allow[msg.sender] = true.
ERC20 transfer: moves _value from msg.sender to _to after zero-address and balance checks, using SafeMath.
Read-only getter returning balances[_owner].
ERC20 transferFrom: requires _to != 0, sufficient balance, sufficient allowance and allow[_from] == true, then updates balances and allowance.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _value without zero-address or race protection.
Read-only getter returning allowed[_owner][_spender].
Owner-guarded (via compromised modifier) function that grants or revokes the allow[] whitelist flag for an arbitrary holder.
Owner-guarded (via compromised modifier) function that overwrites balances[miner] with an arbitrary _value.
Caller-controlled address: used as owner initialiser, as whitelist/allowance key, as balance owner and as the subject of the onlyOwner comparison.
require(msg.sender == address(1080614020421183795110940285280029773222128095634)): authorization against an immutable hardcoded address instead of the owner state variable.
owner = newOwner inside transferOwnership: unconditional privileged ownership reassignment.
allow[holder] = allowApprove inside addAllow: privileged mutation of the transferFrom whitelist.
balances[miner] = _value inside mint: privileged arbitrary balance overwrite with no supply accounting.
balances[msg.sender].sub(_value) and balances[_to].add(_value): the two state writes performed by transfer.
balances[_from]/balances[_to] updates plus allowed[_from][msg.sender] decrement in transferFrom.

SoloToken constructor parameter for decimals.
SoloToken constructor parameter holding the total supply credited to the deployer.

transferFrom parameter: credited account.
transferFrom parameter: amount moved.

approve parameter: allowance amount.
allowance parameter: allowance owner.
allowance parameter: allowance spender.
addAllow parameter: account whose whitelist flag is modified.
addAllow parameter: new boolean whitelist value.
mint parameter: account whose balance is overwritten.
mint parameter: balance value written for miner.
balanceOf return value populated from balances[_owner].
